validation.sameArchiveNote: the separate 14 native + 13 plugin-manager same-archive matrix was not re-run for this optimization patch; the exact tarball verifier, the disposable e2e pack and the six-host isolated gate all read the same archive

performance.mount: startup/controls/grants/runtime open while mounting; multi-row instruments, windows and resources open on first authorized use; a corrupt lazy row degrades that aggregate to unknown instead of aborting mount
performance.capture: per-instance source watermarks (businessRevision, window revision, worktree revision, runtime revision, saved policy revision, resource revision) skip no-op capture; a 2.1s unchanged rebuild test performs only the projection context read
performance.parsing: memoized parses at SessionInstruments.load, history capture read, window revision reads and history query source revisions; worktree bindings already memoized

compatibility.hostRange: 0.2.1-alpha.1 … 0.2.1-rc.2 verified on six real hosts; the declared engine range also admits 0.2.1-alpha.5, 0.2.1 final and 0.2.2-alpha.* through prerelease semantics, which are not verified
compatibility.rc1Check: carried from the 0.4.33 host comparison (unchanged packages): 0.2.1-rc.1 differs from 0.2.1-alpha.4 in 18 of 303 installed packages; every package this plugin uses is byte-identical apart from its package.json version
compatibility.rc2Check: carried from the 0.4.33 host comparison (unchanged packages): across the 305-package 0.2.1-rc.2 install 292 packages are byte-identical apart from package.json version, 11 carry content changes (none used by this plugin), and all 30 packages this plugin uses are byte-identical apart from package.json version
compatibility.sDepth: S.depth publishes direct/deeper/unknown plus per-level counts; direct+deeper+unknown===S.used, levels classify every measured run, and null means the source cannot measure depth. The server parser rejects any inconsistent structure and degrades to countKnown:false with native-subagent-activity-unreadable

review.independentReview: This patch removes no-op work from the projection side effects and defers three multi-row domain opens. Capture now advances per-instance source watermarks only after a successful capture; memoized parsers reuse frozen documents; instruments/windows/resources open on first authorized use, and a dispose race closes any late handle. A mounted test proves an unchanged rebuild does not re-enter history capture (red before the gate, green after); host mount now opens 4 documents with no live agents, not 7. Root suites on alpha.4, rc.2, the dual root and no host root, the exact tarball verifier, the disposable e2e pack and the six-host isolated gate all pass. No S/T, execution admission, storage layout or business-record semantics changed.
